method: Directly viewed all seven final, unmodified UE PNG images through view_image after final foam save.
notes: 100m layout, distinct inland lake and beach retained in overview and top_down.
Round crowns and stones restored by restrained generated-texture contrast; faint triangle texture boundaries remain at close range. Representative FBX normals are continuous.
Lake and sea read as teal water; weaker ground caustics remain visible.
Legacy thin surf ribbons are hidden; white soft crest patches are integrated into the water surface with no floating ribbon shadows.
Fixed-camera water_t0/water_t1 visibly differ in crest patch position and caustic pattern; world shader time also advances.
limitations: Foam retains an analytic band structure and some periodicity; it is a stylized shader approximation, not particle or fluid simulation.
Triangle UV seams are subdued, not removed; no claim of painted seam continuity.
Hello is indirect native-class/PIE evidence, not on-screen text proof from these clean captures.
